excluded_paper_components: The paper investigates 123 technical indicators and feature selection. This example uses only the three-day raw OHLCV window, so it is a Ridge-method adaptation, not the paper's selected-feature experiment.

The source text says the target is a price three days ahead. This example uses the closing price exactly three trading bars after the end of each input window; the source does not fully specify every preprocessing detail.
The paper's thirteen-year AAPL sample, selected indicator list, model scores and experimental returns are not reproduced. A fixed 506-bar public AAPL sample provides a chronological proxy.
The L2 coefficient is fixed to 1.0 and features are standardized using training-only moments; the paper does not specify an exact matching coefficient for this reduced feature set.
Converting the predicted future close to a unit long or short target and next-open fills is a runtime adaptation, not a trading rule attributed to the paper.

steps.runtime_rule: Flatten three completed OHLCV days into one feature row and attach a later available target.
